# Ilangathir Trust (இளங்கதிர் அறக்கட்டளை)

> Registered Charitable Trust in V. Kallupatti, Dindigul (624307), Tamil Nadu, India.
> Registration No: Book - 4/47/2024 | PAN: AACT13541A | Founder & Managing Trustee: Prejeval Prince
> Languages: English (`?lang=en`) and Tamil (`?lang=ta`).

## Summary
Ilangathir Trust (Ilangathir Arakattalai / இளங்கதிர் அறக்கட்டளை), founded by Prejeval Prince, is a community-led charitable trust based in V. Kallupatti, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu, India. The trust works across four pillars:
1. **Student Education Support**: School notebooks, learning kits, scholarships, and academic guidance for rural students.
2. **Free Rural Medical & Eye Camps**: Preventive health screenings, village medical outreach, and elder care.
3. **Environmental Care**: Tree plantation drives, sapling care, and village cleanliness initiatives.
4. **Community Welfare & Relief**: Timely food, essential supplies, and emergency support for underserved families.
